description:
Gaming on a budget doesn’t have to mean compromising on quality. Whether you’re a casual player or a dedicated enthusiast, finding the right accessories can make the precious hours you get to spend in front of your computer that much better… without emptying your wallet.

We’ve dug around and found some of the best PC gaming accessories under $100. Not only will you get top-notch performance, but you’ll get great value too. Let’s dive into the gear that proves great gaming doesn’t have to come with a hefty price tag.

Upgrade your mouse: Razer Basilisk V3 X HyperSpe
title: 8 PC gaming upgrades under $100 that don’t feel cheap
